name: Henry
schedule: First Tuesday, 140 Henry Pkwy, McDonough (judicial in rem sales)
note: Only the current list is posted; amounts owed are behind per-parcel payoff links.

auction.venue: Henry County Tax Commissioner's Office (Henry County Administration Building)
auction.time: First Tuesday of the month when a sale is scheduled, 10:00 am sharp; funds verification begins 9:15 am
auction.registration: Register online before the day of the sale, then finish in person that morning at the Property Tax Department with a driver's license, address and phone number. Your funds are verified in hand before a bidding number is issued, and a $25.00 deed fee is required.
auction.payment: Money order or certified check payable to Henry County Tax Commissioner (the registration page also lists cash); no personal checks and a separate payment for each property. Payment is due at the time of sale and all sales are final.
auction.office: Henry County Tax Commissioner, Property Tax Department
vital: Henry mainly uses judicial in rem sales: the owner has 60 days after the sale to redeem by paying the minimum bid into Superior Court, and the deed issues within 90 days if not redeemed (O.C.G.A. 48-4-75 to 48-4-81).
You cannot bid more than the funds verified that morning, and only registered bidders with a bidding number may bid.
Buyer beware: no guarantees, expressed or implied; see the property before you bid.
Parcels paid at any time before the sale come off the list, and sales are not held every month.
You cannot bid on property that you or your corporation or LLC own.
Any surplus over the minimum bid is deposited with the Superior Court for distribution to interested parties.
